title: Provisions of sections 10A, 10B and 10BB to override all other laws, contracts,
text:
10D. Provisions of sections 10A, 10B and 10BB to override all other laws, contracts,

etc.— Any appointment or removal of a [director, chairman of the Board of directors who is appointed
on a whole-time basis or managing director] in pursuance of section 10A or section 10B [or section
10BB] shall have effect and any such person shall not be entitled to claim any compensation for the loss
or termination of office, notwithstanding anything contained in any law or in any contract,
memorandum or articles of association.]
